name: Calf Raise with Resistance Band
how_to:
1. Setup: Secure a resistance band to a low anchor point behind your feet.
2. Grip the Band: Attach handles to the band ends and grasp one handle in each hand, arms straight and palms facing backward.
3. Starting Position: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart. Keep your spine tall, shoulders slightly retracted, and arms relaxed behind you holding the tensioned band.
4. Raise: Press through the balls of your feet and lift your heels off the ground slowly, engaging your calves as you rise.
5. Pause and Contract: At the top of the movement, squeeze the calves and hold for 1–2 seconds to emphasize the peak contraction.
6. Lower Slowly: Descend under control, allowing your heels to return just below parallel for a full stretch.
7. Repeat: Perform the desired number of reps while maintaining consistent band tension.
